subject: Adding a data bind concept to Shiny

messages.author: 5712068fdf482d27
messages.subject: Adding a data bind concept to Shiny
parts:
As I am learning more about Javascript I see that this AngularJS framework from Google seems to be getting a lot of buzz and appears to be really popular.

In particular I like this concepting of data binding in AngularJS where you can bind a variable in JavaScript to a {{string}} in the HTML/DOM

I think it would be nice if Shiny can implement such a feature. It would look something like this

index.html

...
<p> There are {{vars} variables to choose from </p>

server.R

foo <- reactivevalues(some.var.in.r = 10)

output$vars <- bind(foo$some.var.in.R)

Now every time foo$some.var.in.R get changesd the HTML/DOM also changes by replacing {{var}} with whatever was assigned to foo$some.var.in.R

I believe this can already be achieved with the current Shiny constructs. But I thought providing the bind abstraction actually lessens the amount code needed to achieve this and is much easier to understand.

Thoughts?
